title: A new class of orthogonal polynomials
summary: We consider random walk polynomial sequences $(P_n(x))_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}\subseteq\mathbb{R}[x]$ given by recurrence relations of the form $P_0(x)=1$, $P_1(x)=x$ and $x P_n(x)=a_n P_{n+1}(x)+c_n P_{n-1}(x)\;(n\in\mathbb{N})$, where $a_n$ and $c_n$ are positive and sum up to $1$. $(P_n(x))_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}$ is said to satisfy nonnegative linearization of products if the product of any two polynomials $P_m(x)$, $P_n(x)$ is a convex combination of $P_{|m-n|}(x),\ldots,P_{m+n}(x)$.
